name: growth-skills
description: Growth teardowns for mobile subscription apps, for product designers: web funnel, onboarding, the onboarding-paywall seam, upsells, the first weeks before renewal and the cancel flow. Each scores what can be changed on screen out of 100 (never rewarding pressure), flags store and dark-pattern issues, and ranks tests by published evidence. A router picks the right one. Works with Subscription Skills for benchmarks, paywall teardown and store rules.
